governed_by: egohygiene/antidote#45, egohygiene/antidote#77, egohygiene/antidote#41, egohygiene/antidote#46, and egohygiene/antidote#82
format_policy: Exact architecture and claim-bearing diagrams use deterministic SVG; scientific tables use governed LaTeX backed by structured data when applicable; generated editorial artwork may use high-resolution PNG only with a prompt record and human label verification.
accessibility_policy: Captions remain outside image pixels in the centralized LaTeX registry. Every visual has distinct caption, alt text, and long description; color is never the sole carrier of meaning; PDF, web, grayscale, print, and reduced-vision review are required before final state.
licensing_policy: Every source declares its license and provenance. Third-party or generated material cannot become active until reuse rights, attribution, model identity, prompt history, and human verification are recorded.
reuse_policy: The paper manifest remains authoritative. PDF and accessible web are canonical projections; future magazine reuse is a derived projection and cannot strengthen claims or silently replace captions, descriptions, provenance, or state.

visuals.caption: Person-and-moment inspectability chain separating an approved semantic journey, measured acoustic realization, actual exposure, response, and any later advisory proposal.
visuals.alt_text: Four ordered cards move from a person and moment through a semantic journey and acoustic realization to exposure-linked response, with a human-reviewed future proposal returning below.
visuals.long_description: Four numbered cards run left to right. Person and moment holds chosen context and desired direction; semantic journey holds intent, stages, constraints, and approval; acoustic realization holds the content-hashed artifact and measured features; exposure and response distinguishes what was heard from what was reported. Every forward transition is a proposed relationship to test rather than a causal or therapeutic mechanism.

visuals.title: Holistic two-rate closed-loop architecture
visuals.scientific_purpose: Separate uncertain, human-correctable deliberation from deterministic generate-ahead rendering and expose authority, timing, and failure boundaries.
visuals.label: fig:holistic-two-rate-architecture

source.provenance: Repository-authored deterministic SVG redrawn from an author-approved AI-assisted concept using research/notes/ADAPTIVE_AUDIO_ARCHITECTURE.md and governed runtime boundaries, then reviewed for final visual production under issue #46; no generated raster or external asset is embedded.
source.license: Original Antidote deterministic SVG; publication license pending.

visuals.caption: Proposed two-rate Antidote architecture. Human-correctable deliberation authorizes one immutable generation specification; variable-latency generation fills a verified future-audio buffer that decouples model work from deterministic playback deadlines. Labels distinguish the executable synthetic slice from proposed components.
visuals.alt_text: Two stacked regions show human-correctable deliberation above and a generation-to-audio path below. One approved specification enters a bounded model worker, verified audio moves into a future buffer, and only rendering and playback operate to audio deadlines. Stop bypasses deliberation; response can create only a future human-reviewed proposal.
visuals.long_description: The numbered path begins with consented context, a correctable state belief, semantic intent, a journey plan, and explicit human approval. Approval produces one immutable generation specification that crosses into a capability-scoped model adapter. Variable-latency generation and verification prepare future audio before the proposed deterministic renderer consumes small audio blocks and segment boundaries for a deliberate playback path. Exposure remains a separate record of what was actually heard, and a response remains a separate observation that can return only as a dashed future proposal requiring human review; no automatic learning path exists. Solid cards identify the executable synthetic slice, dashed cards identify proposed capabilities, and split cards distinguish current mock or schema support from target behavior. The listening/exposure and response cards are split because playback state and response schemas exist while no qualifying human exposure or response is observed. Separate cancel, approved-fallback, and immediate-stop paths bypass semantic deliberation. The provenance spine requires source, version, hash, and authority lineage while explicitly making no claim of truth, privacy, safety, benefit, hard-real-time generation, or human outcome.
